# Sadman Zaman Khan — Portfolio & Profile

> Personal portfolio and design archive of Sadman Zaman Khan — UI/UX Designer & AI-Augmented Prototyper crafting enterprise dashboards, AI-native product interfaces, brand systems, and design systems.

## Professional Summary

Sadman Zaman Khan is a UI/UX Designer and AI-Augmented Prototyper based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, currently working at SJ Innovation LLC. He specializes in bridging high-fidelity interface design with production-grade AI tools, including Google Antigravity, ComfyUI, and modern design system architecture.

- Current Role: UI/UX Designer at SJ Innovation LLC (Dhaka, Bangladesh)
- Education: Munshiganj Polytechnic Institute (Diploma in Engineering in Computer Science, 2021 – 2025; Rover Scout Senior Patrol Leader & Rover Scout Leader)
- Core Competencies: UI/UX Design, Design Systems, Enterprise Dashboards, AI-Augmented Prototyping, Google Antigravity, ComfyUI, Figma Token Architecture, React, Framer Motion, Motion Graphics.

## Flagship Case Studies

- [CollabAI Redesign](https://sadmanportfolio.vercel.app/work/collabai-platform): Complete redesign of an AI-native workspace featuring a unified Global Composer, multi-model streaming canvas, and live interactive before/after comparisons.
- [Nexura](https://sadmanportfolio.vercel.app/work/nexura): Enterprise analytics and workflow automation dashboard with strict information hierarchy.
- [Control Tower](https://sadmanportfolio.vercel.app/work/control-tower): Enterprise monitoring system and operational dashboard.
- [Ephysician](https://sadmanportfolio.vercel.app/work/ephysician): Telemedicine and clinical compliance platform (HIPAA & PCI compliant).
- [Nagae Studio](https://sadmanportfolio.vercel.app/work/nagae-studio): Luxury bridal boutique management CRM and AI stylist platform.
- [Noborangi](https://sadmanportfolio.vercel.app/work/noborangi): Complete brand identity and retail packaging suite for a contemporary lifestyle brand.
